addons.title: Top Ramen Crafting
addons.notes: /topramencraft (or /trc) opens the crafting planner: what to craft to level up, what makes money, and what to buy, with prices from its own auction house scan (Auctionator optional).

addons.title: Top Ramen Explorer
addons.notes: /tre finds the spots you still need for the Adventure > Explorer achievements and guides you there. /tre help for options.

addons.title: Top Ramen Farm
addons.notes: /trfarm opens the farm tracker. Press Start farming, loot things, and it tallies what you've made: vendor value vs. selling smart on the auction house. Toggle it off when you're done. At a merchant, the Vendor items button sells the items you ticked. The Goal tab shows how long until your mount, dual spec or epic mount.

addons.title: Top Ramen Gear
addons.notes: /trg opens your class gear window, separated by spec. See what gear in your bags is the best while also getting an easy-to-use hunt list for items in any future dungeons. Not sure how much of an upgrade a dungeon drop is? Now you can compare the level of upgrade to anyone else who has the addon!

addons.title: Top Ramen ThunderCats
addons.notes: /trtc opens the ThunderCats window. When you cast Shifting Power it plays a ThunderCats clip: shuffle between the clips you tick, or always play the one you pick. Play buttons let you hear each clip first, and a volume slider sets how loud they are. Sometimes stay quiet skips some casts so it doesn't get overdone.

testAddons.title: Top Ramen Map
testAddons.notes: /trmap opens a big live minimap and a whole-dungeon overview with boss pins and routes. /trmap help for options.
